newsitem.title: PERU: Dead Peruvian soldier killed in jungle, not raid.
newsitem.headline: Dead Peruvian soldier killed in jungle, not raid.

text.p: A Peruvian soldier died at Lima's military hospital on Saturday from wounds sustained in a jungle clash with rebels and not in the rescue raid at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima, a relative said on Saturday.

Sgt. Raul Alvarez, 20, died from an injury received in Tocache in Peru's eastern jungle region last year after a gun battle with Maoist Shining Path guerrillas, his father, Simeon Alvarez, told Reuters at his burial.

Earlier, local radio CPN reported Alvarez was the third commando to have died after Tuesday's assault on the diplomatic mansion that rescued 71 of 72 hostages held by Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels.
Army patrols frequently clash with MRTA and Shining Path guerrillas in their jungle strongholds.
Two army officers died in Tuesday's assault. One hostage and all 14 MRTA rebels were also killed in the rescue mission, which came on the 126th day of the hostage standoff.
